name: Mesoriver
description: The region’s most developed and notable city has earned the title of capital for being the magical city of Tanares. The city is composed of many towers, floating islands, and even castles levitating, with many trying to display their wealth and power. With many tameranium pylons and elemental creatures spread throughout the city, many magic items are powered by the auras of minerals. It is possible to find many curious features: • Houses with living architecture capable of shape changing; • Transportation options include disks, flying boats, transportation circles, and flying carriages for romantic purposes; • Magical utilities: while within the city, many devices and wands can create day-to-day effects, like everburn fire to illuminate places; • Extensive use of illusions for entertainment purposes, like showing magical beasts, dragons combats, and many others; • Perfect weather control to create pleasant temperatures or, in some specific areas, be either cold or hot. However, despite its magnificence, this city harbors many dangers. Some spells may cause explosions, elementals can get loose and attack people, summonings can go out of control, and the teleportation circle may malfunction and send people to unsafe areas. Recently, two major concerns have frightened people in the city. A powerful mastermind invoked from the Elemental Plane is trying to release the elementals, and some wizards have been disappearing from the higher towers without a trace. The Arcane Enforcers are investigating but recruiting adventurers to assist them.
